REPORT on Student Club Inauguration and Technical Talk

The Department of CSE (Data Science) launched its technical club DataNauts on 14 th May 2025 at AB401, in the presence of Dr. Basavaraj L (Principal), Dr. Anitha D B (Associate Professor & HOD), and Mr. Yogabalaji G, Decision Scientist at Mu Sigma Inc., Bengaluru.

As part of the launch, a technical talk on “How Data is used to Build Solutions and Maximizing Efficiency” was conducted for 4 th and 6 th semester students, coordinated by the staff members of the department and students.
